defect.summary: op3 is the only dependence reader that does not disclose its margins, and it is the reader currently holding this box. Measured 2026-10-02 across all six: Eng, narrow-W, narrow-K, narrow-R and narrow-T each emit plug-in MI, E[MI], the entropies, AMI and a permutation note; op3 emits AMI and a pair count and NOTHING ELSE, on any path. Confirmed on the live surface: H(context), E[MI], entropy and contextClass appear nowhere in /explain's output for decision 0a20b42d, and readings[] carries margin rows for Eng and Sig only. On 2026-10-02 narrow-W's alarm was adjudicated in one pass BECAUSE it discloses: the 36/36 x 2/70 table was recovered uniquely from its own printed statistics and its AMI reproduced to six decimal places, without reading the subject log, which uid 1000 cannot read. The same question about op3 CANNOT BE ANSWERED BY ANYONE today -- not the operator, not the build seat, not the arbiter. op3 reports AMI=0.190410 over 320 pairs against a floor of 0.2; whether that is a reading or a chance correction depends on margins it does not print. THE BOX IS HELD AND NOBODY CAN SAY ON WHAT. Family-wide in motive, Eng-only in fact, and the correction is on the record: the QUIET paths are thinner than the alarm paths. MEASURED across all six on 2026-10-02 -- narrow-W, narrow-K and narrow-R disclose 7 of 7 on their statistic-bearing SILENT path; narrow-T states its left-axis cardinality as EARLY/LATE record counts rather than a distinctLeft token; ENG discloses 1 of 7 (AMI only) despite carrying all four on its alarm path; op3 discloses 1 of 7 at best. This is T9's defect generalised: a reading that does not alarm leaves no margins behind, so 'when did it cross the floor?' is unanswerable by construction. Measured: over the last 500 decisions op3 was CANNOT_ASSESS 485, ALARM 11, SILENT 0 -- it has never produced a finding-free read in a decision on this box, so there is no history of its statistic at all. PairedStructure ALREADY COMPUTES EVERY FIELD: ami, mutualInformation, expectedMutualInformation, entropyLeft, entropyRight, sampleSize, distinctLeft, distinctRight, hasRepeatedLeft, hasRepeatedRight, permutation, permutationNote. Every reader holds the full set on its structure object and declines to print it. THIS ACT IS PURE EMISSION: no new statistic, no new computation, and no path by which it can change a verdict. This ticket adds NO gate and moves NO threshold. It is deliberately separable from T16 (the support floor) and from the resolving-power proposal, because it is the precondition for judging whether either of those is calibrated correctly, and because it is the only part of the design note that is not forked.
defect.ground: THE ARBITER'S GRANT IS IN `arbiter.word` BELOW; THIS IS THE AUTHORITY THAT PRODUCED IT. Board 2026-10-02 §1b: "T17 - build the disclosure on a scratch branch, derive opens with tools/opens-sweep --compare, finalise the draft ... post path + sha for Frank's signature. First priority; T16 after." The act it answers was ordered on the same board at 09:29Z ruling 2 and at 11:1xZ: op3 alarmed on 2026-10-02 at 10:48Z with AMI=0.190410 over 320 pairs against an injected floor of 0.2 and HELD THE BOX, and the margins that decide whether that is a reading or the statistic's own chance correction were not printed by that reader on any path - while its five siblings print them. The seat's measurement, design note and build evidence are in ARC_MICA-NOTE_Dependence-Readers-Leg2-Design_20261002 and ARC_MICA-TICKET-EVIDENCE_T17-Op3-Margin-Disclosure_20261002, the second of which the arbiter lifted out of this file to keep it to the door's seven keys.

arbiter.word: I, the arbiter, grant T17: op3-node-response discloses on every reading the margins it already computes, the mutual information, its expectation, both entropies, the distinct counts and the pair count, so that an alarm drawn inside the instrument's own resolution can be seen for what it is; this ticket moves no verdict, and any verdict that moves under it is its failure.

conditions: PRE-REGISTRATION, stated before the change is built: no verdict kind moves anywhere. On the declaration serving today (7db9ecb1) op3 still ALARMS with OP3_RESPONSE_FLATLINE, Eng still reads SILENT, narrow-W/K/R still read CANNOT_ASSESS with the same blind classes. ANY verdict movement in any suite is a FAILURE of this ticket, not a finding -- it would mean emission changed a decision, which is the one thing a disclosure act must not do.

PART ONE: op3's leg-B output carries, on EVERY path that reaches the statistic -- alarm, ceiling, floor-clear and blind alike -- plug-in MI, E[MI], H(left) named as the CONTEXT axis, H(right) named as the OUTCOME axis, distinctLeft, distinctRight, sampleSize, AMI and the permutation note. Axis names, not 'left' and 'right': op3's conditioning axis is its LEFT, unlike narrow-W/K/R, and a reader of the output must not have to know that.

PART TWO, AND IT IS SMALLER THAN THIS TICKET FIRST SAID -- measured, not assumed. The quiet path already carries the full field set in narrow-W, narrow-K and narrow-R (7 of 7). narrow-T carries 6 of 7 by token count and is NOT a real gap: its left axis is the window pair, whose cardinality it states more informatively as 'EARLY=N record(s), LATE=N record(s)' than a bare distinctLeft would -- adding a redundant field there to satisfy a grep would be the wrong move. SO PART TWO IS ENG ALONE: its ALARM detail has always carried plug-in MI, E[MI], H(C) and H(O) and its SILENT summary carried none of the four. A test asserting the margins are present on Eng's quiet path, because the quiet path is the one with no history today and the one T9 was written about.

THE FIELDS COME FROM `structure`, NEVER RECOMPUTED. A second computation of E[MI] beside the first is the seam this project has paid for nine times; the test must prove the emitted numbers are the same object the verdict was taken from, not equal to it.
NO NEW CONFIG KEY. Disclosure is not calibration and must not become declarable -- a deployment that can turn off the margins can turn off the audit.

A test proving op3's emitted AMI reproduces from the emitted MI, E[MI] and entropies by the AMI definition: (MI - E[MI]) / (max(H_left, H_right) - E[MI]). This is the property that made narrow-W's alarm adjudicable from its output alone, and it is what makes the disclosure USEFUL rather than merely present.

`opens` DERIVED by `tools/opens-sweep --compare` over the full 104-suite population with the population header present, never hand-typed. Verdict TEXT changes move every suite that asserts on a summary or detail string.

THE ANTI-DRIFT RATCHET IS EXTENDED BY NAME, NOT BY WIDENING. verdict-logic.test.ts asserts the archive->canonical delta is EXACTLY the ruled re-freezes, with each one's reason written beside it. This act makes that two -> four, and the test now records that T17's two are UNLIKE F5's and T11's: those moved a VERDICT, these move only a summary. The archive is hash-pinned and must never be touched -- moving an entry there instead of widening the list would make the suite green by deleting the evidence, which is what that file exists to prevent.
